component.name: Astrill Lazy Router
component.summary: Direct and Astrill routing policy control

description.p: A native Ubuntu controller and DD-WRT companion for routing services, websites, devices, and isolated applications either directly or through the active Astrill tunnel.
Add native-only inspection, reversible native-policy overlays, configurable reboot-persistent noVNC, and secure macOS and Windows launchers.
Adds synchronized native Astrill settings, incremental policy semantics, route recommendations, complete minimum bypass profiles, and native-only restoration.
Adds country policy visibility, a distinct Astrill endpoint browser, complete LAN inventory sources, router operations, and Nutstore.
Adds 260 service profiles, catalog filters, desktop login startup, and automatic router companion reconciliation.
